Description: Station storage foundation (bounded scope): private-by-default S3 buckets for documents, static assets, email attachments, DOCX staging, and upload staging, plus an optional generic encrypted Station backup destination bucket (default disabled) for a separate backup identity/process, S3-to-SQS event notification plumbing for documents/static, and the static-file metadata DynamoDB table. NOT a deployment: no provisioning, no live AWS calls, no attachment to existing IAM roles, no automatic backup copy job or schedule.

Environment.Description: Deployment environment tag applied to all resources. Purely descriptive; does not change resource behavior.

StationOriginUrl.ConstraintDescription: Must be an https:// origin: scheme plus host and optional port only, no path and no trailing slash.
StationOriginUrl.Description: The single Station web origin allowed by CORS on buckets that accept direct browser uploads (documents, static, upload staging). Must be validated HTTPS.

DocumentsBucketName.Description: Exact name of the durable documents bucket (plugged in by the operator; not generated here).
DocumentsBucketName.ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket name: 3-63 characters, lowercase letters, digits, dots, and hyphens only, starting and ending with a letter or digit.

StaticBucketName.Description: Exact name of the durable static-assets bucket.
StaticBucketName.ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket name: 3-63 characters, lowercase letters, digits, dots, and hyphens only, starting and ending with a letter or digit.

EmailAttachmentsBucketName.Description: Exact name of the email attachments bucket.
EmailAttachmentsBucketName.ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket name: 3-63 characters, lowercase letters, digits, dots, and hyphens only, starting and ending with a letter or digit.

DocxStagingBucketName.Description: Exact name of the transient DOCX-unzip staging bucket.
DocxStagingBucketName.ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket name: 3-63 characters, lowercase letters, digits, dots, and hyphens only, starting and ending with a letter or digit.

UploadStagingBucketName.Description: Exact name of the transient bulk/client upload staging bucket.
UploadStagingBucketName.ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket name: 3-63 characters, lowercase letters, digits, dots, and hyphens only, starting and ending with a letter or digit.

EnableBackupBucket.Description: Whether to create a distinct, generic encrypted Station backup destination bucket for a separate backup identity/process to write into. Defaults to false until a backup provider and copy/export mechanism are approved; this template only provisions the destination and isolated writer/restore IAM policies, never an automatic copy job or schedule.

BackupBucketName.Description: Exact name of the distinct backup bucket for documents. Required only when EnableBackupBucket is true.
BackupBucketName.ConstraintDescription: Must be empty (when backup is disabled) or a valid S3 bucket name: 3-63 characters, lowercase letters, digits, dots, and hyphens only.

StaticMetadataTableName.Description: Exact name of the static-file metadata DynamoDB table (schema mirrors services/static_file_service/src/service/dynamodb/model.rs).
StaticMetadataTableName.ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid DynamoDB table name: 3-255 characters, letters, digits, underscores, hyphens, and dots only.

DocumentsQueueName.Description: Exact name of the SQS queue receiving S3 ObjectCreated notifications from the documents bucket.
DocumentsQueueName.ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid SQS queue name: 1-80 characters, letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores only.

DocumentsDlqName.Description: Exact name of the dead-letter queue for the documents notification queue.
DocumentsDlqName.ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid SQS queue name: 1-80 characters, letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores only.

StaticQueueName.Description: Exact name of the SQS queue receiving S3 ObjectCreated notifications from the static bucket.
StaticQueueName.ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid SQS queue name: 1-80 characters, letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores only.

StaticDlqName.Description: Exact name of the dead-letter queue for the static notification queue.
StaticDlqName.ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid SQS queue name: 1-80 characters, letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores only.

DocumentsNoncurrentVersionExpirationDays.Description: Conservative retention for superseded versions in the documents bucket before permanent deletion.

StaticNoncurrentVersionExpirationDays.Description: Conservative retention for superseded versions in the static bucket before permanent deletion.

BackupNoncurrentVersionExpirationDays.Description: Longer retention window for superseded versions in the backup bucket, since it exists specifically to outlive mistakes in the primary documents bucket.

StagingObjectExpirationDays.Description: Conservative TTL for all objects in the DOCX-staging and upload-staging buckets (both are transient by design).

EmailAttachmentsTempPrefixExpirationDays.Description: TTL for the temp/ prefix in the email attachments bucket (mirrors existing repo convention).

AbortIncompleteMultipartUploadDays.Description: Days before an incomplete multipart upload is aborted and its parts reclaimed, applied to every bucket.

QueueVisibilityTimeoutSeconds.Description: Visibility timeout for the documents/static notification queues, sized for downstream finalizer/consumer processing time.

QueueMessageRetentionSeconds.Description: Message retention for the main notification queues (default 4 days).

DlqMessageRetentionSeconds.Description: Message retention for dead-letter queues (default 14 days, matching existing repo DLQ convention).

MaxReceiveCount.Description: Number of delivery attempts before a message moves to its DLQ.

EmailAttachmentsNoncurrentVersionExpirat.Description: Conservative retention for superseded versions in the email attachments bucket before permanent deletion. Versioning is enabled explicitly so the temp/ prefix TTL is not the only recovery mechanism for accidental overwrite/delete.

Assertions.AssertDescription: BackupBucketName must be a non-empty, valid S3 bucket name when EnableBackupBucket is true.

Properties.Description: Least-privilege object access for the documents bucket only. Not attached to any role by this template.
Least-privilege object access for the static bucket plus scoped read/write on the static-file metadata table and its GSI. Not attached to any role by this template.
Least-privilege object access for the email attachments bucket only. Not attached to any role by this template.
Least-privilege object access for the DOCX staging bucket only (unzip pipeline). Not attached to any role by this template.
Least-privilege object access for the upload staging bucket only. Not attached to any role by this template.
Least-privilege consumer access to the documents/static notification queues (not their DLQs). Not attached to any role by this template.

Write-only (no delete) access to the Station backup destination bucket, intended for a separate backup-writer identity only. Not attached to any role by this template, and never referenced by any app-facing access policy.

Read-only restore access to the Station backup destination bucket, intended for a separate backup-restore identity only. Not attached to any role by this template, and never referenced by any app-facing access policy.

DocumentsAppAccessPolicyArnOut.Description: Managed policy ARN for documents-bucket app access (unattached)

StaticAppAccessPolicyArnOut.Description: Managed policy ARN for static-bucket + metadata-table app access (unattached)

EmailAttachmentsAppAccessPolicyArnOut.Description: Managed policy ARN for email-attachments-bucket app access (unattached)

DocxStagingAppAccessPolicyArnOut.Description: Managed policy ARN for docx-staging-bucket app access (unattached)

UploadStagingAppAccessPolicyArnOut.Description: Managed policy ARN for upload-staging-bucket app access (unattached)

NotificationQueueConsumerPolicyArnOut.Description: Managed policy ARN for documents/static queue consumer access (unattached)

BackupWriterAccessPolicyArnOut.Description: Managed policy ARN for the separate backup-writer identity (write-only, no delete; unattached)

BackupRestoreAccessPolicyArnOut.Description: Managed policy ARN for the separate backup-restore identity (read-only; unattached)
